question: What bodily form results from constant practice of this yoga?
premises: Constant practice yoga is the means.
A form of two-times-eight years is named.
This form becomes the practitioner's state.
inference: Through constant practice of this yoga, one attains the form of a sixteen-year-old.
uncertainties: dvi-aṣṭa-varṣa-ākṛtiḥ is interpreted as the appearance of sixteen years.
plain_english: Through constant practice of this yoga, one attains the form of a sixteen-year-old.
